2302333767644454498.name: Equestrian Statue of Carol I
2302333767644454498.summary: A monumental bronze equestrian statue of Romania's first king, set among Bucharest's grand historic buildings and ideal for a quick photo stop.

84644100838256775.name: Piața Revoluției
84644100838256775.summary: Historic Bucharest square centered on a Revolution memorial, with an obelisk, statues and landmark buildings including the Royal Palace and Athenaeum.

15439727830362881762.name: Restaurant Hanu' lui Manuc
15439727830362881762.summary: Historic Romanian inn with a large courtyard, traditional music, and hearty local dishes that draw both visitors and locals.

4799452667097853425.name: St. Anthony’s Church
4799452667097853425.summary: A small, atmospheric Orthodox church in Bucharest's Old Town, known for sixteenth-century heritage, frescoes, icons, Brancovenesc details, and a peaceful courtyard.

8814498684371616875.name: Constitution Square
8814498684371616875.summary: A vast civic square beside Bucharest's Palace of Parliament, known for monumental views, fountains, major concerts and a festive Christmas market.

14153328836806999902.name: "Saint John Chrysostom" Church
14153328836806999902.summary: Small Orthodox chapel with bright frescoes, icons, a relic of St. John Chrysostom, and a flower-filled garden beside Bucharest's National Cathedral.

15978145016794525298.name: University Square
15978145016794525298.summary: Historic central Bucharest square framed by the university and grand civic buildings, with statues, events, cafes, and a lively route into the Old Town.

8825391489902434532.name: The Italian Church
8825391489902434532.summary: A small red-brick Italian Catholic church in central Bucharest, blending neo-Romanesque and neo-Gothic design with vivid murals and a peaceful interior.

11484690504626613379.name: Boteanu Church
11484690504626613379.summary: A small, historic Orthodox church in central Bucharest, known for its layered history, painted interior, icons, and intimate services.

4243283208342501467.name: Yeshua Tova Synagogue
4243283208342501467.summary: Active Chabad synagogue in central Bucharest, offering Jewish prayer, Shabbat gatherings, a warm community atmosphere, and kosher food.

6889785889460410985.name: Cinema Park Floreasca
6889785889460410985.summary: Compact, well-kept neighborhood park with shady trees, flower beds, fountains, playgrounds, fitness equipment, and a small football area.

10134766061891588360.name: Parcul Floreasca
10134766061891588360.summary: A green neighborhood park with old trees, flower-lined paths, varied children's playgrounds, dog-friendly space, jogging routes, and an outdoor pool.
10134766061891588360.address: Strada Locotenent Aviator Radu Beller 31, 014192 București

13586446863539050445.name: "Nicolae Iorga" Park
13586446863539050445.summary: A compact, leafy oasis on central Calea Victoriei, with shaded benches, playgrounds, basketball, fitness and table tennis around a Nichita Stanescu statue.
13586446863539050445.address: Parcul Nicolae Iorga, Intrarea Nicolae Iorga 4, București, Romania

6556823942046256710.name: "Antim" Monastery
6556823942046256710.summary: A serene Brancovenesc Orthodox monastery with carved doors, frescoed passages, a quiet courtyard, and a free museum near central Bucharest.
6556823942046256710.address: Strada Mitropolit Antim Ivireanul 29, 040111 București, Romania

15434284566899275827.name: The Patriarchal Cathedral
15434284566899275827.summary: A serene Orthodox cathedral on Patriarchal Hill, with Brancovenesc architecture, vivid frescoes, a sacred interior and broad Bucharest views.

4003415631141903301.name: Dealul Mitropoliei
4003415631141903301.type_label: Orthodox cathedral and historic religious hill
4003415631141903301.summary: A serene historic hilltop complex housing Bucharest's Orthodox cathedral, with peaceful walks, religious heritage, and views toward the Palace of Parliament.

623836095872856917.name: The New "Saint Spyridon" Church
623836095872856917.summary: Monumental Orthodox church in Bucharest with Gothic-influenced architecture, vivid frescoes, stained glass, a peaceful garden, and a serene interior.

556613190747548448.name: Radu Vodă Monastery
556613190747548448.summary: Historic Orthodox monastery in central Bucharest, known for serene gardens, striking frescoes, active services, and relics of Saints Nectarios and Ephraim.

12643890721772099082.name: Biserica "Sfântul Mina Vergu"
12643890721772099082.summary: Historic Orthodox church with Brancovenesc character, richly painted interior, and Saint Mina relics; a compact, peaceful place for prayer and heritage.

6194615972455793446.name: The New "Saint George" Church
6194615972455793446.summary: Historic Orthodox church with lavish frescoes, mosaics, carved columns and the ornate tomb of Constantin Brancoveanu in central Bucharest.

10915586233752676659.name: The Church of the "Stavropoleos" Monastery
10915586233752676659.summary: A tiny eighteenth-century Orthodox monastery church with ornate Brancovenesc carvings, vivid frescoes, a peaceful cloister and a serene courtyard in Bucharest Old Town.

5806071778867054569.name: National Museum of Romanian History
5806071778867054569.summary: A grand Bucharest history museum in a former post office, known for Trajan's Column, Dacian gold, royal jewels, and a compact toy collection.

13310905076871302877.name: Museum of the Palace of the Parliament
13310905076871302877.summary: Tour the colossal Palace of the Parliament for marble halls, grand staircases, vast chandeliers and a sobering look at communist-era ambition.

15791376739079194771.name: Zlatari Church
15791376739079194771.summary: Historic Orthodox church in central Bucharest, known for ornate frescoes, rare stained glass, a peaceful interior, and revered Saint Cyprian relics.

10146158162049940249.name: St. Nicholas in-a-Day Church
10146158162049940249.summary: A small historic Orthodox church in central Bucharest, with a modest exterior, richly painted interior, icons, and a peaceful courtyard atmosphere.

7192375974987078804.name: Museum of Communism in Bucharest
7192375974987078804.summary: A compact, hands-on museum of Romanian communism, with authentic household objects, room replicas, historical panels, vintage clothes and helpful guides.

17991847120941406752.name: Darvari Skete
17991847120941406752.summary: A serene Orthodox skete in central Bucharest, with a simple white church, interior frescoes, a leafy garden, and a rare sense of retreat from city noise.

4761944489402296337.name: Zambaccian Art Museum
4761944489402296337.summary: An intimate villa museum pairing major Romanian art with French masters including Renoir, Matisse, Cezanne and Picasso, plus courtyard sculptures.

15789628688656153058.name: "Ceaușescu" House
15789628688656153058.summary: Tour the preserved Spring Palace, Ceausescu's opulent former residence, for lavish interiors, mosaics, an indoor pool, gardens, and a stark view of communist privilege.

16415991869468704082.name: Herăstrău Lake
16415991869468704082.summary: A vast artificial lake in Bucharest's King Michael I Park, with scenic walking and cycling paths, boating, greenery, lakeside dining and beautiful sunsets.

6077420982585694938.name: Bucharest Herăstrău Park
6077420982585694938.summary: Bucharest's large lakeside park is made for long walks, cycling, boat rides and relaxed terrace stops around a peaceful urban oasis.
6077420982585694938.address: Şoseaua Pavel D. Kiseleff 32, 014192 București, Romania

9430379915622433187.name: "Dimitrie Gusti" National Village Museum
9430379915622433187.summary: A peaceful open-air museum of authentic Romanian village homes, churches, mills, and rural traditions set among trees beside a lake.

7437828600189140797.name: Cașin Church
7437828600189140797.summary: Grand Orthodox church near Bucharest's Arc de Triomphe, known for its domes, Byzantine-style mosaics, painted interior and active religious life.
7437828600189140797.address: Bd, Strada Alexandru Constantinescu, 012073 București, Romania

1300292552306378781.name: Grigore Antipa National Museum of Natural History
1300292552306378781.summary: Explore Bucharest's standout natural history museum, filled with lifelike wildlife dioramas, dinosaur skeletons, fossils, minerals, insects and a humpback whale skeleton.

4658405126684418777.name: Saint Joseph’s Catholic Cathedral
4658405126684418777.summary: Ornate nineteenth-century Catholic cathedral with Gothic and Romanesque details, stained glass, frescoes, a marble altar, organ music, and a peaceful interior.
4658405126684418777.address: Palatul Arhiepiscopal, Strada General H. M. Berthelot 19, București

15387643079662744112.name: White Church Bucharest
15387643079662744112.summary: A small, elegant Orthodox church with a whitewashed facade, Brancovenesc details, Tattarescu paintings, peaceful worship, and a celebrated choir.

2323796184066607182.name: National Museum of Romanian Literature
2323796184066607182.summary: A richly presented museum of Romanian literary culture, with manuscripts, writers' belongings, artworks, interactive displays and audio guides in a restored historic house.

9762822817967543429.name: Velonova Mirage 3D Museum
9762822817967543429.summary: An immersive Bucharest museum of optical illusions, interactive 3D scenes and recycled-metal sculpture rooms, built for playful photos with friends or family.

6975675940809821901.name: Kretzulescu Church
6975675940809821901.summary: Compact red-brick Orthodox church from the 1720s, rich with Brancovenesc detail, frescoes and a quiet spiritual atmosphere beside Bucharest's Revolution Square.

16044012576954065712.name: National Museum of Art
16044012576954065712.type_label: national art museum in a former royal palace
16044012576954065712.summary: A grand former royal palace housing Romanian, European, Islamic and East Asian art, with medieval icons, modern masters, sculpture and ornate historic rooms.

7134420911640911719.name: The Royal Palace of Bucharest
7134420911640911719.type_label: Art museum in a former royal palace
7134420911640911719.summary: Bucharest's ornate former royal residence now houses Romania's national art museum, with grand interiors, royal rooms, and major Romanian collections.

9185679158235506995.name: Artmark
9185679158235506995.type_label: historic art auction house and gallery
9185679158235506995.summary: Browse rotating art, jewelry, furniture and collectibles inside a beautifully restored historic palace that also hosts auctions and cultural events.

12264421749383794754.name: Palatul Cesianu-Racoviță
12264421749383794754.summary: A refined historic palace turned free art gallery, with painted interiors, changing auction displays, Romanian art, jewelry, antiques, and sculptures.

3676382838556882236.name: "Theodor Aman" Museum
3676382838556882236.type_label: historic house museum and art museum
3676382838556882236.summary: A compact 19th-century artist's home and studio filled with Theodor Aman's paintings, engravings, carved furniture, stained glass, and preserved interiors.
3676382838556882236.address: Strada C. A. Rosetti 8, 010283 București, Romania

2158015732788621536.name: Art galleries Horizon
2158015732788621536.summary: A quiet central art gallery for temporary exhibitions of contemporary and decorative art, including glass, painting, sculpture, and textile work.

554707036502269048.name: Nicolae Dabija Park
554707036502269048.summary: Compact neighborhood park with a shaded playground, benches, and adult exercise equipment, best suited to local families and a quiet morning break.
554707036502269048.address: Piața Gen. Nicolae C. Dabija 32, 030167 București

9700208711465968276.name: Parcul Izvorul Rece
9700208711465968276.summary: A tiny traffic-island park with a fountain, Balcescu bust, old trees and benches - a distinctive spot for a brief rest or photo stop.
9700208711465968276.address: Parcul Izvorul Rece, Bulevardul Pache Protopopescu, 030167 București, Romania

14147436869860924214.name: "Ion Mincu" Memorial House
14147436869860924214.summary: A carefully restored former home of architect Ion Mincu, now an intimate heritage venue for architecture exhibitions, concerts, conferences, and cultural events.
14147436869860924214.address: Strada Pictor Arthur Verona 19, 030167 București, Romania

8943340123139727326.name: Parohia Pitar Moşu
8943340123139727326.summary: A small, peaceful Orthodox church with distinctive interior painting, active Sunday services, and a deeply devotional atmosphere.

6243762450561891153.name: "Cazzavillan" Park
6243762450561891153.summary: A small Italianate pocket park centered on a historic statue fountain, with columnar trees, quiet benches, a playground, and strong architectural-photo appeal.

12043161798547449749.name: Operei Park
12043161798547449749.summary: A small, leafy urban park beside Bucharest's Opera House, with shaded paths, benches, greenery and children's play areas for a quiet break.
12043161798547449749.address: Parcul Operei, Splaiul Independenței 273, 060042 București, Romania

1479141875587392152.name: Romniceanu Park
1479141875587392152.summary: A small, leafy Cotroceni neighborhood park with a quiet atmosphere, hilltop paths, an artesian fountain, playgrounds, and space for a short break.

55295570421893244.name: Lake Cișmigiu
55295570421893244.type_label: Lake in a historic city park
55295570421893244.summary: A tranquil lake in Bucharest's historic Cismigiu Park, with shaded paths, scenic water views, and seasonal boat rides or skating.

15198693957308866935.name: Memorial of Rebirth
15198693957308866935.summary: A stark, controversial marble-and-metal memorial in Bucharest's Revolution Square, honoring those who died in the 1989 Romanian Revolution.

13484124012727544921.name: George Enescu Square
13484124012727544921.summary: A central Bucharest square beside the Athenaeum, royal palace and museums, known for historic surroundings, open-air concerts and cultural festivals.

855038458486232843.name: Shaorma Orient
855038458486232843.type_label: shawarma and kebab fast food counter
855038458486232843.summary: Long-running shawarma spot with fast service, generous portions, and a loyal late-night following, known for pork, schnitzel, and strong garlic sauce.

16415238605323312024.name: Parcul Bibescu Vodă
16415238605323312024.summary: Compact central Bucharest park with a statue of Barbu Catargiu, a familiar meeting point, and a brief urban pause amid surrounding traffic.

8936184002675932170.name: Doruleților Park
8936184002675932170.summary: A compact neighborhood park with a children's play area, a local setting between apartment blocks, and a calm, family-oriented feel.

16683488054308569238.name: Timpuri Noi Park
16683488054308569238.summary: A small, leafy neighborhood park with trees, grass and shade, offering a quiet green pause for relaxation, dog socializing and a brief break from the city.

72316001405398303.name: Foișorul latino🥳 (latino dance)
72316001405398303.summary: A lively open-air pavilion in Lumea Copiilor Park for salsa, bachata and kizomba, with social dancing, workshops and a friendly community.

374916765702954360.name: Lacul Carol
374916765702954360.summary: A landscaped lake in Carol Park with fountains, a bridge, grassy resting spots and paths for a peaceful stroll, fresh air and urban nature.

4819213249581818347.name: Grădina Uranus
4819213249581818347.summary: Rustic-industrial garden and outdoor event venue, best known for Balkanik Festival, concerts, and a lively cultural atmosphere in central Bucharest.

6888593115770266135.name: Tribunalului Park
6888593115770266135.summary: A small, shaded neighborhood park with a well-equipped children's playground, fitness area, benches, and quiet paths between city buildings.

16102257020469288161.name: Parcul TNB
16102257020469288161.summary: Small central Bucharest park opposite the National Theatre, known for its Caragiale-themed bronze sculpture ensemble and a quiet place to pause.

4113312426607151481.name: Monument of Iuliu Maniu
4113312426607151481.summary: A bronze statue of democratic politician Iuliu Maniu in Revolution Square, a reflective historic stop near Bucharest's 1989 landmarks and famous balcony.

10934602441818715559.name: Kretzulescu Park
10934602441818715559.summary: Small, central urban park beside Kretzulescu Church, offering a quiet bench break, grassy patches and an easy pause between Bucharest sights.

11789953336918761413.name: Kiseleff Park Lake
11789953336918761413.summary: A small lake in Kiseleff Park, surrounded by greenery, benches and walking paths, with ducks and geese adding a peaceful urban nature break.
11789953336918761413.address: Şoseaua Pavel D. Kiseleff, București, Romania

4633978135206059774.name: "9 Mai" Park
4633978135206059774.summary: Small, quiet urban park with shaded benches, a children's playground, sports facilities, dog areas, and a relaxed neighborhood atmosphere.

4697082106517235626.name: The Dendrological Park of the Agronomics Institute
4697082106517235626.summary: A spacious, quiet Bucharest park filled with diverse trees, shrubs and seasonal flowers, best known for its beautiful peony garden in spring.

2432760961753622230.name: USAMV Botanical Garden
2432760961753622230.summary: A quiet university botanical garden with themed plantings, spring peonies, tulips and roses, offering a well-kept urban escape for leisurely walks.

7807918081033621872.name: Insula Trandafirilor
7807918081033621872.summary: Rose Island is a leafy lake islet in Bucharest's Herastrau Park, linked by bridges and lined with roses, European leaders' sculptures, and water views.

14520410630316479424.name: Lake Floreasca
14520410630316479424.summary: A peaceful urban lake ringed by green parks, walking routes, benches, birdlife and pontoons for kayaking, boating and lakeside relaxation.

1193420506378278679.name: Lake Tei
1193420506378278679.summary: A peaceful urban lake and neighborhood park with walking paths, water birds, children's play areas, sunset views, and a large observation wheel.

6798890718005674528.name: George Călinescu Park
6798890718005674528.summary: A small, green neighborhood park with a well-equipped children's playground, plentiful benches, and a calm setting for family breaks or a short stroll.
6798890718005674528.address: Parcul George Călinescu, Strada Locotenent Aviator Șerban Petrescu 1, București, Romania

8847982075973563191.name: Brâncuși Park
8847982075973563191.summary: A tiny, shaded neighborhood green space with benches, mature trees and pigeons - a calm short stop amid busy central-city traffic.

9085047711132783084.name: Education Point
9085047711132783084.summary: Central Education Point is a flexible indoor venue for courses, workshops, conferences and meetings, with spacious rooms, modern equipment and occasional exhibitions.

7910810057186574218.name: Statue of George Enescu
7910810057186574218.summary: A bronze seated monument to Romanian composer George Enescu, set low at a busy central Bucharest intersection for a quick cultural stop.

6153831670984642249.name: The New & Old Building
6153831670984642249.summary: A small Bucharest landmark where a traditional historic facade meets a bold glass structure, creating a striking architectural contrast in Revolution Square.

17060919567617799701.name: Galle Store
17060919567617799701.summary: A gallery-like showroom of elegant paintings, bronzes, wrought iron, decorative glass and distinctive gifts, with polished luxury styling.
17060919567617799701.address: Strada Ion Câmpineanu Nr3, 010031 București, Romania

13459769578362302506.name: Fountain
13459769578362302506.summary: A low-key fountain in Bucharest's Revolution Square, with shaded benches, nearby monuments and changing multicolour illumination after dark.

8303113599182351171.name: Rondul Bicicliștilor
8303113599182351171.type_label: Cycling meeting point in a city park
8303113599182351171.summary: A free, relaxed cycling meeting point inside Izvor Park, with benches and open space for a short stroll or rest near Parliament.

16731499042548548557.name: Broscuțe Park
16731499042548548557.summary: A colorful neighborhood park with a repaired working fountain, a pleasant kids area, and a calm setting between residential blocks.

6629192582604785501.name: Nicolae Găină Park
6629192582604785501.summary: Small, quiet neighborhood park with mature trees, green space, covered benches, a children's playground and outdoor exercise equipment.

10806071642509399861.name: Bujoreni Park
10806071642509399861.summary: A compact, clean neighborhood park with rose plantings, benches, bright lighting, walking paths, and a colorful playground for young children.

17835345623740364596.name: Timișoara Park
17835345623740364596.summary: A clean, newer neighborhood park with playgrounds, sports areas, benches and outdoor gym equipment, suited to relaxed walks, family time and exercise.

1388595737490931087.name: Museum of Senses Bucharest
1388595737490931087.summary: A playful sensory museum in AFI Cotroceni with optical illusions, mirror mazes, a vortex tunnel, VR and highly photogenic interactive rooms.

3463608227957701491.name: "Dimitrie Brândză" Botanical Garden
3463608227957701491.summary: A spacious Bucharest botanical garden with tropical greenhouses, ponds, mature trees and winding paths, blending calm nature walks with seasonal light shows.

7777417464195066635.name: The Mound
7777417464195066635.summary: A leafy central Bucharest park with shaded paths, an artificial lake, boat rides, benches, and a peaceful escape from city noise.

3327560521143573631.name: The Gallery of European Art
3327560521143573631.summary: A palace-set gallery of European masterpieces, with royal-collection highlights by Rembrandt, Rubens, El Greco, Bruegel, Monet and Rodin.

2357537659727089689.name: Mântuleasa Park
2357537659727089689.summary: A tiny, tree-shaded urban pocket park split by a road, with an Eliade monument, benches and a low-key spot for a short central-Bucharest pause.
